title: 第5章 扇他，使劲的扇他第6章 忽悠，使劲的忽悠

第五章 扇他，使劲的扇他
“张羊我跟你说，这巨剑的奥妙就在一个‘力’字上，有人过来你就扇他，没人过来你就站着不动，那样你就立于不败之地了。”叶石说着。
张羊在一旁背着巨剑，像小鸡啄米一样的点着头，现在对大哥的话，他是没有半点怀疑。尤其大哥还说，那些人可能会出言侮辱他，逼他放弃优势，这点大哥也给了应付之策，大哥如此为他，他怎么能够辜负大哥呢。
“现在来说，你只能这样做，等到以后适应了巨剑，就算遇见灵巧的对手也不用怕。”叶石不厌其烦的说着。
使用巨剑不代表只能守株待兔，只是张羊初次使用巨剑，适应不了巨剑的笨重和攻击技巧，叶石才给出这点提议。而以后的事情也交待一下，树立自己的光辉形象。
“大哥英明。”张羊回答着，听了大哥的话，他突然感觉未来一片美好，而这都是大哥给他带来的。
今天大哥更是放下生意，亲自陪他过来打气，这让张羊感觉一阵温暖。可惜厚实的张羊不知道叶石打得主意，否则不知道会不会拿着从叶石买来的巨剑，就像叶石所说的，扇他，使劲的扇他。
临近一间庄园，张羊脚步慢了下来，小声对叶石说道：“大哥，前面的天水庄园就是了，那庄园里规矩繁多，大哥千万不要离开我身边，出了事我才可以帮大哥顶着。”
天水庄园，本就是高日城的贵族场所，其中不仅是年轻一代聚集，就连一些有着实权的父辈一代都会来此，据说就连城主大人，一个月也会过来两三次。
尽管因为这样而规矩繁多，但这里还是年轻一代聚集之地，为啥，因为这里就是身份的象征，没有点身份，你是进不来这里的。
而且年轻一代都是聚集在庄园的一个偏院，在那里任凭打闹，只要不出大事，没有人管得着他们。而今天，年轻一代聚集，其中几个眼瞧着张羊的精明妹妹没过来，便起了欺负张羊的注意，这不，就把张羊给欺负的跑回家拿剑了。
等了这么久，就在年轻一代讨论张羊是不是躲在家里不敢出来了，一堂哄笑的时候，张羊便带着叶石进来了。
叶石这样的无名小卒，是不足够进入庄园的，但前面有张羊张大少带着，庄园的奴仆便不敢拦了。那些世家子弟能够欺负张羊，但他们这些奴仆可不敢，尤其现在张大少郁闷着，谁知道会不会触了眉头，被当做出气羊了。
“怎么，肥羊你知道打不过，还带了帮手？”一名世家子弟上前取笑道。
这世家子弟名为李民宇，家族李家在高日城也是大家族，只是和张家有些话不投机，连带着家族子弟都看对方不顺眼，今日之举有很大部分就是他推动的。
顿时一片嘲笑声起，只剩下几个和张家交好的世家子弟没有笑，但也没有出口替张羊出头的想法。
张羊被气得脸色一阵青一阵红，就要上前和那李民宇拼了，却被叶石拉住，对着张羊摇了摇头。张羊因为心中对叶石感动，加上路上的教导让张羊尊敬，现在张羊可是真当叶石做大哥看了。
张羊没有上前，叶石则是走上一步，道：“在下叶石，是一个铸剑师，张少不想耽搁各位比斗的兴趣，所以刚刚在小店买了一柄剑，在下听闻此事，也就跟着来了，只要剑有损伤，在下能够为其修补，这样就不会在出现耽搁比斗的情景了。”
众人一片恍然，原来是这样，顿时连李民宇看着叶石的目光也顺眼起来。剑坏了马上修，这样就不怕张羊逃了，就算张羊的性格逃跑可能性极低，但是耽搁这么长时间，这些世家子弟是很不耐烦的。
张羊有些着急了，大哥怎么能这么说话，正想开口，就见大哥对他打起眼色，目光有意无意的瞄向那李明宇几人的剑，张羊顿时明白了。这哪里是在灭自己威风，原来大哥打得是这注意。

张羊尽管厚实，但并不是笨蛋，他能够带剑按约回来，李民宇可不一定，要是等会他把李明宇的剑整坏了，李明宇回家拿怕是回不来了。但有大哥在就没问题了，不用担心李民宇待会会跑。
李民宇心情挺爽的，只是张羊的目光好像有些暧昧，让他感觉有些不对，但始终说不出来哪里不对，这样的情况让李民宇难得的烦躁了起来，“废话少说，亮剑吧。”
“好嘞。”张羊也不客气，取下背着后面的巨剑，一抡抡在身前，那巨大的模样顿时把在场众人吓了一跳。
这哪里是剑啊，不是一块稍微改改菱角的铁板吗，有不少人已经笑了出来，就算那几个和张家交好的子弟，也是憋着嘴，忍不住就要笑出来了。
都说这张家肥羊大少傻，以前还觉得不怎样，现在看来所说属实，拿着一块铁板当剑用，也只要张羊这傻小子才做得出来。
“肥羊，这就是你的剑？”李民宇也取笑着，原本的那股担心早不知道抛到哪里去了，一下子取下自己的佩剑，走到张羊的面前，“来，今天就让我来告诉你，什么叫做剑。”
叶石在一旁也笑了，你们就继续嘲笑吧，那样等到结果出来你们就更加震撼，那时推销自己的剑，肯定事半功倍，金币滚滚来。
张羊也笑了，李民宇站着的距离刚刚好，自己不用动就扇中李民宇。接下来只要秉持大哥的教诲，扇他，使劲的扇他。
“咳咳。”这时一世家子弟像裁判模样的走了上前，装模作样的咳嗽了两声，才道：“现在继续之前的比斗，开始。”
话才刚落下，张羊便抡起巨剑使劲一扇，李民宇被张羊的刚猛吓了一跳，连忙用剑防御，不想一阵巨力传来，李民宇感觉手上一震，还没怎样呢就被扇飞了出去。
而那名裁判模样的世家子弟，因为站的太近不巧也在巨剑抡动范围内，同样被扇飞出去，飞行中他只是在想，怎么他话才刚说完，就有阵黑影传来，自己就飞出去了。
噗噗，两声落地声，带来一阵目瞪口呆，除了张羊兴奋的叫喊着，就只剩下一群瞪大双眼，不明真相的围观观众。

Chapter 5: Slap him, slap him hard
"Zhang Yang, let me tell you, the secret of this giant sword lies in the word 'power'. If someone comes over, slap them. If no one comes over, just stand still. That way you will be invincible." Ye Shi said.
Zhang Yang was carrying a giant sword on his back, nodding his head like a chicken pecking at rice. Now he had no doubts about his elder brother's words. Especially the eldest brother also said that those people might verbally insult him and force him to give up his advantage. The eldest brother also gave him strategies to deal with this. How could he let down his eldest brother if he was so kind to him?
"For now, you can only do this. When you get used to the giant sword in the future, you don't have to be afraid even if you meet a dexterous opponent." Ye Shi said tirelessly.
Using a giant sword does not mean that you have to wait and see. It was just Zhang Yang's first time using a giant sword and he couldn't adapt to the heavy weight and attack skills of the giant sword, so Ye Shi gave this suggestion. And I will also explain the future matters and establish a glorious image of myself.
"Brother is wise." Zhang Yang replied. After listening to his words, he suddenly felt that the future was bright, and this was all brought to him by his eldest brother.
Today, the eldest brother even put down his business and came with him to cheer him up, which made Zhang Yang feel warm. It's a pity that the thick Zhang Yang didn't know Ye Shi's idea, otherwise he wouldn't have taken the giant sword he bought from Ye Shi and slapped him as hard as Ye Shi said.
Approaching a manor, Zhang Yang slowed down and whispered to Ye Shi: "Brother, that's the Tianshui Manor in front of you. There are many rules in that manor. Brother, please don't leave my side. Only when something goes wrong can I help you."
Tianshui Manor was originally a noble place in Gaori City, where not only the younger generation gathered, but also some powerful fathers’ generation came here. It was said that even the city lord would come here two or three times a month.
Although there are many rules because of this, this is still a place where the younger generation gathers. Why, because this is a symbol of status. Without some status, you can't get in here.
Moreover, the younger generation all gathered in a side courtyard of the manor, where they allowed themselves to fight, and no one could control them as long as nothing serious happened. But today, the younger generation gathered together. Seeing that Zhang Yang's shrewd sister didn't come, some of them started to bully Zhang Yang. Then they bullied Zhang Yang and ran home to get the sword.
After waiting for so long, just when the younger generation was discussing whether Zhang Yang was hiding at home and dared not come out, and everyone was laughing, Zhang Yang came in with Ye Shi.
An unknown person like Ye Shi was not enough to enter the manor, but with Young Master Zhang Yang in front, the servants of the manor did not dare to stop him. Those children of the aristocratic family can bully Zhang Yang, but their slaves dare not, especially now that Young Master Zhang is depressed. Who knows whether he will be frowned upon and treated as a angry sheep.
"Why, you know you can't beat the fat sheep, so you brought a helper?" A kid from an aristocratic family stepped forward and teased.
The son of this aristocratic family is named Li Minyu. The Li family is also a big family in Gaoricheng. However, there are some disagreements with the Zhang family. Even the children of the family dislike each other. A large part of today's actions was driven by him.
Suddenly there was a burst of ridicule, and only a few children from aristocratic families who were friends with the Zhang family did not laugh, but they did not express the idea of ​​standing up for Zhang Yang.
Zhang Yang was so angry that his face turned green and red, and he was about to step forward to fight with Li Minyu, but Ye Shi pulled him back and shook his head at Zhang Yang. Zhang Yang was moved by Ye Shi in his heart, and Zhang Yang was respected by his teachings on the road. Now Zhang Yang really regards Ye Shi as his elder brother.
Zhang Yang did not come forward, but Ye Shi took a step forward and said: "I, Ye Shi, am a swordsmith. Mr. Zhang doesn't want to delay everyone's interest in the competition, so he just bought a sword in a small shop. When I heard about it, I followed him. As long as the sword is damaged, I can repair it, so that there will be no delays."Forget about the competition scene. "
Everyone was stunned, it turned out to be like this, and even Li Minyu looked at Ye Shi with pleasant eyes. If the sword is broken, repair it immediately, so that you won't be afraid of Zhang Yang escaping. Even if Zhang Yang's character is very unlikely to escape, these children of the aristocratic family are very impatient after such a long delay.
Zhang Yang was a little anxious. How could his eldest brother speak like this? Just as he was about to speak, he saw his eldest brother winking at him and looking at the swords of Li Mingyu and others intentionally or unintentionally. Zhang Yang understood immediately. This is not destroying his prestige. It turns out that the elder brother is paying this attention.
Although Zhang Yang is thick, he is not stupid. He can bring the sword back as promised, but Li Minyu is not sure. If he breaks Li Mingyu's sword later, Li Mingyu may not be able to come back when he returns home. But as long as the big brother is here, there will be no problem. There is no need to worry about Li Minyu running away later.
Li Minyu was in a good mood, but Zhang Yang's eyes seemed a little ambiguous, which made him feel something was wrong, but he still couldn't tell what was wrong. This situation made Li Minyu feel a rare irritation, "Stop talking nonsense and show your sword. "
"Okay. "Zhang Yang was not polite. He took off the giant sword on his back and swung it in front of him. The huge appearance immediately startled everyone present.
This is not a sword. Isn't it an iron plate with slightly modified water chestnuts? Many people have already laughed. Even those who are good friends with the Zhang family are holding back their mouths and are about to laugh.
People say that Zhang Yang, the fat sheep of the family, is stupid. I didn't think it was a big deal before, but now it seems that what they said is true. Only a stupid boy like Zhang Yang can use an iron plate as a sword.
"Fat Sheep, is this your sword? "Li Minyu also teased. He didn't know where to throw away his original worry. He took off his sword and walked up to Zhang Yang. "Come on, let me tell you today what a sword is. "
Ye Shi also laughed on the side, so you can continue to laugh, then you will be even more shocked when the results come out. By then, promoting your sword will definitely get twice the result with half the effort, and the gold coins will roll in.
Zhang Yang also laughed. Li Minyu stood at just the right distance, and he slapped Li Minyu without moving. Next, just follow the teachings of the elder brother and slap him, slap him hard.
"Ahem. "At this time, a member of the first family stepped forward like a referee, pretended to cough twice, and then said: "Now let's continue the previous fight, let's begin. "
As soon as he finished speaking, Zhang Yang swung his giant sword and slapped him hard. Li Minyu was startled by Zhang Yang's fierceness and quickly used his sword to defend himself. Unexpectedly, a huge force came from Li Minyu. Li Minyu felt his hand shake, and he was slapped away before he could do anything.
The referee-like son of an aristocratic family, who happened to be within the swing range of the giant sword because he was standing too close, was also sent flying. As he was flying, he was just thinking about why, as soon as he finished speaking, there was a black shadow coming from him, and he flew out.
Pop-pop, two landing sounds brought a moment of stunned silence. Apart from Zhang Yang shouting excitedly, there were only a group of spectators with wide eyes and no idea of the truth.
